_note: snappyHexMesh profile. Merged only when mesher = snappy, before the case config. snappy's keys live in their own sections (snap, layers, mesh_quality, mesh_params), so this profile carries only what a project needs to retune the engine.
_override_how: Repeat a key in your case config, or drop configs/meshers/snappy.json in your project to override the shipped profile for every case.
